abstract conceptual illustration, no humans, black void, a single slender fractured ivory circle containing a ghostly reflection of an empty modern city, inverted concrete building silhouettes dissolving into charcoal ink, one thin muted vermilion filament crossing the broken ring

Minimal cinematic title-sequence visual for a story about a contaminated city in winter. Symbolic, mysterious, quiet, elegant. Not a literal environment.

Wide horizontal canvas, 75 percent pure near-black negative space. Small off-center broken ring at 60 percent width, approximately one third of canvas height. Buildings are only suggestions inside its lower arc. Asymmetric void. No frame. Lower left is completely black.

Matte soot black, chalk ivory, ash grey, one tiny vermilion accent. Hand-painted edges, dry brush, ink bleeding, crisp focal fracture. No glossy metal, no neon, no magic glow.

arknights, game promotional illustration, painterly anime illustration. Complete, clean silhouettes and carefully resolved facial features and hands. Use clear grouped shadows and angular cloth folds. Keep fine linework selective around the eyes, fingers and accessories. Skin has delicate restrained transitions. Alternate crisp focal edges with softer background edges while keeping contours complete. Rich but controlled color, precise focal detail, quieter background detail.
